name: apna-billing
description: Apna Billing - All-in-one business billing & management platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix license-server install && npm --prefix admin-panel install && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix tauri install && npm --prefix admin-tauri install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,LICENSE,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:license" "npm run dev:admin:web"
scripts.build:license: npm --prefix admin-panel run build && npm --prefix license-server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix license-server test && node e2e/licensing-e2e.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
